sources.label: Official Bershka UK product-page size guide (See measurements, Body, cm): Round neck long-sleeve T-shirt

audit: Old /uk/help/size-guide redirects to the home page. No standalone chart; product-page 'See measurements' gives body bust/waist/hips per size in cm. Same figures on a second T-shirt and on a dress (XS-L). Old XS 78/60/83 now 80/62/88, M 86/68/91 now 92/74/100, L 91/73/96 now 98/80/106, XL 97/79/102 now 104/86/112. XXS added, XXL removed (not on the items checked), UK/US/EU removed (not printed in the guide). Items also list garment measurements, not stored.
